Most VC-backed startups are Delaware C-Corps, so they deal with several types of tax at once: federal income tax, state and local taxes, payroll taxes, sales tax, and the Delaware franchise tax. Kruze handles all of them:
C-Corps pay federal income tax at a 21% flat rate. We prepare and file your federal return (Form 1120), due April 15 for calendar-year filers, with a six-month extension available to October 15.
